verification_note: sin(x)=0 returns a Family (not a Solutions list); generator at n=0,1,-1 gives 0, pi, -pi as designed; cos(x)=1 collapses correctly to a single 2*pi-period family giving 0, 2*pi, -2*pi. Real bug found and fixed during verification: the negative-n case (gen(-1)) came back as +pi instead of -pi -- the bit-trick next_up/next_down enclosure silently drops the sign of a negative float (it was only ever proven correct for positive doubles), fixed by bracketing the magnitude and negating rather than bit-tricking a negative value directly
